scope: Ubuntu local delivery only; not production/main/push

tls.source: existing nginx base image; no product source commit label

performance_policy.cold_first_screen: most measured cold displays below 3 seconds; proxy/TLS/upstream outliers retained

known_limitations: External TLS/response-header tails may exceed 3 seconds or fail; failures remain observable errors, never history boundaries.
Cold PostgreSQL measurements use running HTTP pools; they are not a universal cold-TLS performance guarantee.
No real notifications sent; alert evidence measures internal historical crossing dispatch, not delivery network latency.
Million-bar cleanup throughput and every-frame/all-vendor-state loading UI are not claimed.
notes: Images built from the source snapshot; final tag adds documentation, acceptance records and the user-revised browser performance gate without runtime source changes.
Immutable image label market-watch.accepted=false records build-time candidate state. This final manifest records subsequent local acceptance.
Release image aliases point to the existing tested image IDs; no runtime rebuild or restart for documentation changes.
Runtime secrets/TLS fixtures and licensed vendor binaries are excluded from Git.
